title: Create Sorted Array through Instructions
summary: Given an integer array instructions, construct a sorted array by inserting each element from left to right.
statement: Given an integer array instructions, construct a sorted array by inserting each element from left to right. The cost of each insertion is the lesser of the count of elements already in the array that are less than the current element or the count of elements that are greater. Sum these costs for all insertions, modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Before each insertion, cost is min(number strictly smaller, number strictly greater); equal values count toward neither.
hints: Prefix counts answer how many inserted values lie below a threshold.
Use a Fenwick tree keyed by value.
For each x, query x-1 for smaller and inserted-query(x) for greater, add their minimum, then insert x.
The tree contains exactly the prior multiset, so the two prefix expressions implement both strict comparisons.

tests.explanation: Only inserting two costs one, so total cost is one.
The last two insertions contribute one and two, totaling three.
